edit.description: §3's `Fanout only` extraEnv bullet and the `for fanout` scoping around it

summary: Retire the fanout-only scoping of setupWorktree in docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md §3 and src/setupWorktree.ts's header — singletons provision too
acceptance: No prose in docs/ or src/ scopes setupWorktree or extraEnv to fanout; the extraEnv scope note states what runSingleton does.
notes: docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md:807 states `Singleton phases never invoke setupWorktree, so they never carry extraEnv`. src/Dispatcher.ts:1840 invokes it from runSingleton and consumes extraEnv; tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:674 pins that green; docs/MIGRATING-0.12.md:29 announced the change. The spec sentence the docs contradict is the `Both concurrencies carry the hooks and extraEnv` clause.
